author: marcfeuermann
body:
From PMID:18216282 it is indeed rather retrograde transport. I've removed the suspicious annotation and directly created and propagated GO:0042147: retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi, for both families.
I've also updated CC for Vps55/Vps68 complex (GO:0034424) when required.
